name: Check units and re-read before bubbling
definition: Before committing an answer, spend three seconds on two questions: is this in the units they asked for, and is this the quantity they asked for. Most lost marks on questions a student can do are lost here.
recognizeWhen: the answer should be in minutes not hours
the choices are given in a different unit
you calculated the part but they wanted the whole
before you write the letter down
misconceptions: I gave the answer in centimetres when the choices were in metres.
I solved everything correctly and then wrote down the wrong letter.
I answered the question I expected rather than the one printed.
